source.datasheet_title: CC1352P SimpleLink High-Performance Multi-Band Wireless MCU Datasheet

notes: total_sram_bytes (80 KB) is the general-purpose figure: 'the ultra-low leakage system static RAM (SRAM) is split into up to five 16-KB blocks and can be used for both storage of data and execution of code.' Two smaller pools exist and are deliberately excluded from this total: an 8-KB cache usable as general RAM (disabled by default, opt-in via the Customer Configuration Area), and a 4-KB Sensor Controller RAM (autonomous-peripheral-oriented, technically CPU-accessible but not general-purpose in normal use). total_flash_bytes (352 KB) is confirmed directly: 'The up to 352-KB nonvolatile (Flash) memory provides storage for code and data.' Fetched directly from ti.com, no blocking; 107 pp., read in full.
